Marius and Melissa

As the day comes to an end you spot two kits hugging and crying.
With their grandfather abandoned during the great trek, Marius and Melissa are now alone in this cold world.
When Marius notices you he starts shouting, calling you names like monster and murderer.
In his crying fit of rage he throws something at you: a small necklace with the picture of an old man on it.
Marius then took Melissa by her paw and ran away.
I did what I had to...
The old man

As the day comes to an end you spot an old man with two kits.
Upon noticing you the old man gives you a laboured smile and stumbles over.
"Thank you for saving us. I am the only family these kits have left.
I know I'm useless with my hands, but I used to be a factory foreman.
Let me help you get your bearings. Oh, and take this — please light it on the day we are saved."
He turns back to the kits, who are smiling with youthful energy, and you are left with a firework in your hands.
I promise, old man

A sorrowful night

As the day comes to an end you lie down in your tent and think back on the many hard decisions you had to make.
One vision haunts your dreams: an old man hugging what looked like his grandchildren.
You doomed them. Sent them to their deaths. Refused their chance of living.
Many don't sleep that night and awake tired.
I am a monster made out of necessity

The tired workforce

As the day comes to an end you lie down in your tent, only to get woken by screaming.
Outside, two beavers are going fist to fist after a heated debate about their abandoned kits.
They're workers tired from labour and travel, and they decided to "indulge" themselves.
You confiscate the goods and go to bed late. Many wake up tired. The tension will be noticeable for days.
We all suffer...
